doc: Golden cross and death cross (John Murphy, Technical Analysis of the Financial Markets, New York Institute of Finance 1999): the 50-day SMA crossing above the 200-day SMA is the golden cross, a long-term bullish signal, and crossing below it the death cross. Both averages are drawn, with a triangle under the bar of each golden cross and over the bar of each death cross. A cross is a lagging signal: both averages are slow, so the move is often under way when it fires. It needs 200 bars before the first value.
